gloss: after the rain; clearing up after rain

definitions.gloss: after the rain; just after rain stops
definitions.explanation: The period right after rain has stopped. Often evokes a fresh, clean atmosphere and carries aesthetic or poetic connotations.

examples.japanese: {雨上|あめあ}がりの{空|そら}に{虹|にじ}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: A rainbow appeared in the sky after the rain.

examples.japanese: {雨上|あめあ}がりの{道|みち}は{水|みず}たまりだらけだった。
examples.english: The road after the rain was full of puddles.

examples.japanese: {雨上|あめあ}がりの{公園|こうえん}を{散歩|さんぽ}すると、{木々|きぎ}の{緑|みどり}がいつもより{鮮|あざ}やかに{見|み}えた。
examples.english: When I took a walk in the park after the rain, the green of the trees looked more vivid than usual.

notes:
USAGE:
{雨上|あめあ}がり is used as a noun modifier ({雨上|あめあ}がりの～) to describe the time, atmosphere, or conditions just after rain stops. It carries a pleasant, refreshing connotation — the air feels clean, colors appear vivid, and there is a sense of renewal.
The word is formed from {雨|あめ} (rain) + {上|あ}がり (the end of; finishing). The same ～{上|あ}がり pattern appears in other words like {風呂上|ふろあ}がり (just out of the bath).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨上|あめあ}がりの{空|そら} (the sky after rain)
- {雨上|あめあ}がりの{道|みち} (the road after rain)
- {雨上|あめあ}がりの{匂|にお}い (the smell after rain)
